# sigma_whoami (Data Source)

Retrieves the identity of the authenticated Sigma API principal.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sigma_whoami" "current" {}

output "sigma_user_id" {
  value = data.sigma_whoami.current.user_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable identifier for this data source, equal to user_id.
- `organization_id` (String) Sigma organization ID returned by the whoami API.
- `user_id` (String) Sigma user ID returned by the whoami API.
